newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ETEC Systems a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ETEC Systems a buy.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co reiterated a buy rating on ETEC Systems with a 12-month price target of $50 a share.
-- ETEC makes masks that are used to print circuit patterns on semiconductor wafers.
-- In a statement, analyst Susan Billat noted recent concerns over delayed shipments to DuPont Photomask were "misinterpreted and distorted."
-- Billat said "ETEC is seeing the best production linearity in its history...Our sources suggest that the photomask is increasing."
-- ETEC shares were up 2-1/2 to 33-1/4 by midday.
